scenarios.name: L-U-C-I-D-D-R-E-A-M + ending
scenarios.summary: Shoot the boss, then outrun the lasers
scenarios.description: The map's own sequence from the boss doors (trigger_mcd's outputs, 61.5 s in). You start in the south corridor inside mciddreams_boss_hp_trigger, which adds 30 per human to math_counter_bosshp (starts at 100; GFL's BossHUD "L-U-C-I-D-D-R-E-A-M") as it turns on at 62 s. Leave the arena by 75 s (mciddreams_zombie_tp sweeps it to the zombie side), take the diagonal walkway (it has one-block holes) and jump the one-block gap onto the bridge (road_ending). The boss spawns at its far end at 68 s; stepping onto the bridge starts its lasers (laser_timer, 1 a second at 1100 u/s: low and mid to jump, high to duck). Every bullet on hitbox_boss takes 1 off. Its death (relay_boss_death): at +8 s mciddreams_human_tp sends everyone still near the bridge start to the holding pen, at +15 s the bridge is removed (falling off kills) and the ending lasers fly up its line for 15 s (2 a second: vertical bars to sidestep, high / low beams to duck or jump, 120). Be on the platform past the boss (mciddreams_fail_trigger) at +30 s or the humans are nuked at +31 s; win at +35 s, when mciddreams_human_tp_win takes you on. A laser hit, or being left behind, sends you to the holding pen (mciddreams_huamn_dst): solo that ends the run.

hazards.mciddreams_huamn_dst: the holding pen (a laser hit, or left behind)
